# Verify duplicate-pair hypothesis and build test output
def norm(cells):
    rs=[a for a,b in cells]; cs=[b for a,b in cells]
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
    return tuple(sorted((a-r0,b-c0) for a,b in cells))

def analyze(g):
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=[(c,cells) for c,cells in components(g) if c!=bg]
    # thin lines: components with all cells in one row or one column
    lines=[(c,cells) for c,cells in comps if len(cells)>=5 and (all(r==cells[0][0] for r,_ in cells) or all(col==cells[0][1] for _,col in cells))]
    lines.sort(key=lambda t:-len(t[1]))
    print("thin lines:", [(c,len(cl)) for c,cl in lines])
    line_c, line_cells = lines[0]
    # duplicate silhouette pairs, size>=2
    from itertools import combinations
    for (c1,s1),(c2,s2) in combinations(comps,2):
        if len(s1)>=2 and norm(s1)==norm(s2):
            d1=min(abs(a-r)+abs(b-cc) for a,b in s1 for r,cc in line_cells)
            d2=min(abs(a-r)+abs(b-cc) for a,b in s2 for r,cc in line_cells)
            print(f"pair: color{c1} size{len(s1)} d={d1} vs color{c2} size{len(s2)} d={d2} -> recolor farther to {line_c}")

analyze(d2_in)
analyze(I)

def report(g, line_color, changed, name):
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    lc=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==line_color]
    vr=[r for r,c in lc]; hr=[c for r,c in lc]
    corner=max((r,c) for r,c in lc)  # rough
    print(f"== {name}: line cells rows{min(vr)}-{max(vr)} col?, bbox cols{min(c for r,c in lc)}-{max(c for r,c in lc)}")
    # find corner: cell with two line neighbors
    S=set(lc)
    corner=[(r,c) for r,c in lc if (r+1,c) in S and (r,c+1) in S]
    print("corner:",corner)
    for c,cells in sorted(components(g)):
        if c==bg: continue
        d=min(abs(a-r)+abs(b-cc) for a,b in cells for r,cc in lc)
        rows=[a for a,b in cells]; cols=[b for a,b in cells]
        ch = "CHANGED" if any((a,b) in changed for a,b in cells) else ""
        print(f" c{c} n{len(cells)} rows{min(rows)}-{max(rows)} cols{min(cols)}-{max(cols)} d_line={d} {ch}")
    print()

d1_changed={(r,0) for r in range(13,19)}

d3_changed={(2,8),(3,7),(3,8),(4,7),(4,8)}

def feats(g, line_color, changed, name):
    Hh,Ww=len(g),len(g[0])
    S={(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==line_color}
    corner=[(r,c) for r,c in S if ((r+1,c) in S and (r,c+1) in S) or ((r+1,c) in S and (r,c-1) in S) or ((r-1,c) in S and (r,c+1) in S) or ((r-1,c) in S and (r,c-1) in S)]
    corner=corner[0] if corner else None
    # determine arm directions
    print(f"== {name} corner={corner}")
    print(f"grid {Hh}x{Ww}")
    res=[]
    for c,cells in sorted(components(g)):
        if c==line_color: continue
        rows=[a for a,b in cells]; cols=[b for a,b in cells]
        d_line=min(abs(a-r)+abs(b-cc) for a,b in cells for r,cc in S)
        d_cor=min(abs(a-corner[0])+abs(b-corner[1]) for a,b in cells)
        ch = any(x in changed for x in cells)
        res.append(dict(color=c,n=len(cells),h=max(rows)-min(rows)+1,w=max(cols)-min(cols)+1,
                        r0=min(rows),c0=min(cols),d_line=d_line,d_cor=d_cor,
                        edge=(min(rows)==0 or min(cols)==0 or max(rows)==Hh-1 or max(cols)==Ww-1),ch=ch))
    for r in res: print(r)
    return res
